game_title: Modulo Gate – Cinder Cone Camp Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Cinder Cone Camp open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Cinder Cone Camp open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about gates_open to power up the fire warden and open the cooling vent.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
